notRunAtApproval.statement: Recorded because the release proceeded with these outstanding. None of them was run, and none is claimed to have been. Do not read the v0.2.0 tag as evidence that any of them passed.
whatWasRunInstead: FORMAT, LINT, TYPE CHECK, UNIT, BUILD: `npm run qc` PASS, 8 gates. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. 3632 unit tests pass.

END-TO-END (BROWSER): run locally against the self-host branch before merge — 2070 passed, 39 failed, all pre-existing workbench, archive and audio specs unrelated to this release. It has never completed in CI, because the DEPENDENCY ADVISORIES gate blocks before it.

DEPENDENCY ADVISORIES: fails. 5 advisories (4 moderate, 1 high) in undici, miniflare and fast-uri, reached only through the wrangler and @cloudflare/vite-plugin devDependencies; none ships in the image. `npm audit --audit-level=high` exits 1, `--omit=dev` exits 0.

Self-host container behaviour, verified by hand in a real image built from this tree: gate configured and no credentials sent returns 401 on /, /self-host, /pdf/compress, /robots.txt and an unknown route; the right password returns 200; a wrong one 401. `docker compose up -d` starts and serves, having previously crash-looped.
HSTS, verified against the built Worker: present on /, /self-host and /pdf/compress, exactly once per response.
